content.subject: Vacation Rental Inquiry
content.body:
Thank you for expressing interest in our vacation rental houses. If you provide details
about what you're looking for, we can suggest rental houses that would fit your needs. We're happy to answer any questions.
content.instruction: Respond to the e-mail as if you are looking for a vacation rental house. In your e-mail, ask THREE questions.

content.subject: Fundraising Concert
content.body:
Hi, I heard that there is a concert in the City sometime this month. I want to join this
concert. Please email me with some further details.
Thank you
content.instruction: Respond to this email as if you are an employee of City Convention Hall. In your email, provide at least THREE pieces of information about the concert.
